privacy.001.en: Privacy: what we keep and for how long | bazifor.me
privacy.001.zh: 隐私说明：保存什么、保存多久 / bazifor.me

privacy.002.en: What bazifor.me stores, where it lives, how long it is kept and how to delete it. No account, no email address, and no AI model reads your workspace.
privacy.002.zh: bazifor.me 保存哪些数据、数据放在哪里、保存多久，以及怎么删除。没有账号，不收集邮箱地址，也没有任何 AI 模型读取你的工作区。

privacy.003.en: Privacy: what we keep and for how long
privacy.003.zh: 隐私说明：保存什么、保存多久

privacy.014.en: What we keep, where it lives, and how to remove it
privacy.014.zh: 我们保存什么、数据放在哪里、怎么删除

privacy.016.en: Your data is yours. You typed it in, and you can remove it at any time. This site has no sign-up, so it holds no account, password or email address for you.
privacy.016.zh: 你的数据归你。是你自己输入的，你随时可以删除。本站没有注册环节，所以不保存你的账号、密码或邮箱地址。

privacy.018.en: Only what you type or upload into a workspace:
privacy.018.zh: 只保存你在工作区里输入或上传的内容：

privacy.019.en: for each person: a name or label, sex, date of birth, birth time, and a birth city if you choose one
privacy.019.zh: 每个人的姓名或称呼、性别、出生日期、出生时间，以及你选填的出生城市

privacy.020.en: the relationship label you set for a pair of people
privacy.020.zh: 你为两个人设置的关系标签

privacy.021.en: the homes you add: a name, the rooms you mark on a plan, who you assign to them, and any floor plan image you upload
privacy.021.zh: 你添加的住宅：名称、你在平面图上标出的房间、各房间分给了谁，以及你上传的户型图

privacy.022.en: baby names you save to a shortlist, with the surname, sex, date and time of birth you entered for the baby
privacy.022.zh: 你存入候选名单的宝宝名字，连同你为宝宝填写的姓氏、性别、出生日期和时间

privacy.024.en: Nothing else goes into a workspace.
privacy.024.zh: 工作区里不会有别的内容。

privacy.026.en: A workspace sits behind an unguessable link. Anyone who has that link can read and change the workspace, so treat the link like a key. Sharing the link shares access.
privacy.026.zh: 工作区放在一个无法猜到的链接后面。任何拿到这个链接的人都能查看和修改这个工作区，所以请把链接当作钥匙保管。把链接分享出去，就是把访问权分享出去。

privacy.027.en: The data sits with our hosting providers. The workspace record is in Upstash Redis. Uploaded floor plan images are in Vercel Blob storage, each at its own random address that anyone holding it can open.
privacy.027.zh: 数据存放在我们的托管服务商那里。工作区记录存在 Upstash Redis，上传的户型图存在 Vercel Blob 存储，每张图有各自的随机地址，谁拿到这个地址谁就能打开。

privacy.029.en: A workspace is deleted from our server about six months after the last change to it. Every change restarts that clock.
privacy.029.zh: 工作区在最后一次修改约六个月后，会从我们的服务器上删除。每次修改都会让这六个月重新计时。

privacy.030.en: That timer removes the workspace record. It does not remove uploaded floor plan images. Those are removed when you delete the workspace, or the home they belong to.
privacy.030.zh: 这个计时删除的是工作区记录，不会删除上传的户型图。户型图会在你删除整个工作区、或删除它所属的住宅时一并删除。

privacy.032.en: Open your workspace, find Delete this workspace near the bottom, and confirm. That removes the workspace record and every floor plan you uploaded. It cannot be undone.
privacy.032.zh: 打开你的工作区，在页面下方找到“删除这个工作区”，点一下并确认。这会删除工作区记录和你上传的所有户型图，而且无法撤销。

privacy.033.en: You can also use the API. Send a DELETE request to this address, with your link code at the end:
privacy.033.zh: 你也可以直接调用接口：向下面的地址发送 DELETE 请求，地址末尾填你的链接码：

privacy.035.en: The link code is the last part of your workspace link.
privacy.035.zh: 链接码就是工作区链接的最后一段。

privacy.036.en: If you have lost your link, we cannot find your workspace for you, because it holds nothing that says whose it is.
privacy.036.zh: 如果你弄丢了链接，我们没法替你找到工作区，因为工作区里没有任何能说明它属于谁的信息。

privacy.037.en: No AI model reads your data
privacy.037.zh: 没有 AI 模型读取你的数据

privacy.038.en: No reading is written by an AI model. The engine is deterministic and runs on our server. Your workspace data is not sent to any AI model, and not to anyone else for training or generation.
privacy.038.zh: 没有任何解读由 AI 模型撰写。引擎的结果是固定的，在我们的服务器上运行。你的工作区数据不会发给任何 AI 模型，也不会发给其他任何人用于训练或生成内容。

privacy.040.en: bazifor.me pages load Vercel Web Analytics, which counts visits to pages. The script loads only on bazifor.me. We send it no names, birth data or floor plans, and it is kept apart from your workspace record. Like any script on a page, it can see that page's address. A workspace address contains your private link, so before any event is sent we replace that link with a placeholder: the analytics service receives "/w/[token]", never the link itself.
privacy.040.zh: bazifor.me 的页面会加载 Vercel Web Analytics，用来统计页面访问量。该脚本只在 bazifor.me 上加载。我们不会把姓名、出生资料或户型图发给它，它也与你的工作区记录分开存放。和页面上的任何脚本一样，它能看到这个页面的地址。工作区地址里含有你的私密链接，因此在事件发送之前，我们会把该链接替换成占位符：分析服务收到的是 “/w/[token]”，而不是链接本身。

privacy.042.en: We cannot tell whose a workspace is, so we cannot find yours without its link. We cannot bring back a deleted workspace. Anyone with your link has access, so a shared link is shared access.
privacy.042.zh: 我们没法知道一个工作区属于谁，所以没有链接就找不到你的工作区。我们没法恢复已经删除的工作区。任何拿到你链接的人都有访问权，所以分享链接就是分享访问权。

privacy.043.en: Questions about this page? Contact us.
privacy.043.zh: 对本页有疑问？联系我们。
